messages:
deploy-bot: publish attempt failed for images/redwood-service:release-2026.03.19 in eu-west-1. Reason: Tag immutability violation. Push succeeded to us-east-1 but replication produced a different manifest digest, aborting cross-regional publish.

alice: saw the alert. are we sure this is immutability rather than a registry rewrite during replication?

ben: CI built image (build/20260319-441). we used :latest for the push, which hit our ECR immutability rule in eu-west. error from ECR: "RepositoryPolicy: image tag already exists and is immutable". pushing provenance metadata attempted a second manifest, causing digest mismatch.

tessa: log snippets: 
```
PUT /v2/redwood-service/manifests/release-2026.03.19 -> 400 
{"errors":[{"code":"TAG_ALREADY_EXISTS","message":"image tag already exists and cannot be overwritten"}]}
```

alice: ok, hold the rollout. we should not let canary continue across regions with mismatched manifests. plan: retag to an immutable semver that includes the short git sha and republish to both regions, then update the deployment manifest to pin the new digest.

ben: I'll do the retag + push. new tag: v1.12.3-20260319+0a1b2c. steps: 
1) docker tag sha256:<built-digest> redwood-service:v1.12.3-20260319+0a1b2c
2) docker push us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-service:v1.12.3-20260319+0a1b2c
3) aws ecr replicate-image --source-region us-east-1 --target-region eu-west-1 --image-tag v1.12.3-20260319+0a1b2c
I can start now, ETA ~20m.

ops-oncall: reminder: change window is 14:00-16:00 UTC today. we're already at 14:10. if eu-west doesn't have the pinned image by 14:25 UTC, we should pause and roll back traffic to the previous pinned digest (sha256:abc123def456).

deploy-bot: canary status: 30% traffic promoted in us-east-1. will pause any further promotions if matching image isn't present in eu-west by 14:25 UTC.

tessa: i'll add a short hotfix note in release notes and open a tiny CI change: pre-publish check to fail the job if tag exists and immutability is enforced, plus explicit semver tagging in the pipeline. release notes draft: 
"Hotfix: replaced transient :latest publish with immutable semver+sha tag; added CI guard for immutable tags; ensuring cross-region manifest parity."

alice: sounds good. action owners: ben = republish + verify, tessa = release notes PR, ops-oncall = rollback playbook update and watch the window. ping here when pushed. :thumbsup:

ben: starting retag/push now, will post back with push logs and new digest when done.

deploy-bot: automated note: once both regions have the same digest and the deployment manifest is updated to pin it, I will resume the canary.
